situation.id: Guru Adik datang ke apartemen keluarga Xiǎo. Nenek membuka pintu dan mempersilakannya masuk; saat guru pulang, Adik melambaikan tangan.
situation.en: Little sister's teacher visits the Xiǎo family's flat. Grandma opens the door and invites her in; when the teacher leaves, little sister waves goodbye.

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.en: Hello! Please come in and sit down.

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.en: You're welcome. May I ask, you are...?

situation.id: Jam makan siang di restoran mi yang ramai. Pelayan di pintu menanyakan jumlah tamu kepada Ayah dan Ibu.
situation.en: Lunchtime at a busy noodle restaurant. The waiter at the door asks Dad and Mom how many they are.

situation.id: Pagi hari sebelum berangkat, Kakak mencari HP-nya di ruang tamu. Ibu membantu mencari.
situation.en: In the morning before leaving, big brother looks for his phone in the living room. Mom helps.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 哪个？这个？不对，这是爸爸的。
lines.pinyin: nǎ gè？ zhè gè？ bùduì， zhè shì bàba de。
lines.en: Which one? This one? No, this is Dad's.
lines.id: Yang mana? Yang ini? Bukan, ini punya Ayah.

situation.id: Di kedai kopi dekat kampus, Kakak memperkenalkan sahabatnya kepada Adik.
situation.en: At a coffee shop near campus, big brother introduces his best friend to little sister.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 介绍一下儿，这是我哥们儿。
lines.pinyin: jièshào yīxiàr， zhè shì wǒ gē menr。
lines.en: Let me introduce you: this is my buddy.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: nǐ hǎo！ nǐmen shì tóngxué ma？

lines.speaker: gege
lines.pinyin: bù shìbushì！ tā shì wǒ mèimei。
lines.en: No, no! She's my little sister.

situation.id: Nenek baru pulang ke apartemen dan menanyakan anggota keluarga lain kepada Adik.
situation.en: Grandma comes back to the flat and asks little sister where the rest of the family is.

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.en: Are your mom and dad home?

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: tā zài fángjiān。 tā hěn zhái！
lines.en: He's in his room. He never goes out!

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.id: Kamu turun ke bawah juga, ya.

situation.id: Pulang sekolah, Ibu mengajak Kakak makan di warung mi dekat stasiun metro.
situation.en: After school, Mom takes big brother to a noodle shop near the metro station.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.pinyin: wǒ hěn è！ wǒmen chī shénme？
lines.en: I'm so hungry! What shall we eat?
lines.id: Aku lapar sekali! Kita makan apa?

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 吃面条儿吧。你要包子吗？
lines.pinyin: chī miàntiáor ba。 nǐ yào bāozi ma？
lines.en: Let's have noodles. Do you want baozi?
lines.id: Makan mi saja. Kamu mau bakpao?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.pinyin: yào！ wǒ yě yào yī bēi chá。
lines.en: Yes! And I want a cup of tea too.
lines.id: Mau! Aku juga mau segelas teh.

situation.id: Di gerbang sekolah, teman Adik mengundangnya ke pesta ulang tahun, tapi Adik ada acara keluarga.
situation.en: At the school gate, little sister's friend invites her to a birthday party, but she has a family plan.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.en: The day after tomorrow is my birthday!

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: hòutiān shì lǐ bài tiān ba？

lines.speaker: friend
lines.pinyin: duì！ nǐ lái wǒ jiā ma？
lines.en: Yes! Will you come to my house?

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.cmn: 对不起，礼拜天我不在家。改天吧！
lines.pinyin: duìbuqǐ， lǐ bài tiān wǒ bù zàijiā。 gǎi tiān ba！
lines.en: Sorry, I won't be home on Sunday. Another day!
lines.id: Maaf, hari Minggu aku nggak di rumah. Lain kali, ya!

situation.id: Hari Senin pagi. Ibu membangunkan Kakak yang masih tidur, padahal kelasnya mulai jam delapan.
situation.en: Monday morning. Mom wakes big brother, who is still asleep although class starts at eight.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.pinyin: qī diǎn bàn le！ gǎn jǐn！

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: Let me sleep a little longer...

lines.speaker: mama
lines.pinyin: bù zǎo le！ nǐ bā diǎn shàngkè！
lines.en: It's not early! Your class is at eight!
lines.id: Sudah nggak pagi! Kamu masuk kelas jam delapan!

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: What? What time is it now?

lines.speaker: mama
lines.pinyin: qī diǎn sì shí fēn le。

title.en: Finding the toilet in a mall

situation.id: Kakek berbelanja di mal besar dan bertanya kepada penjaga toko di mana toiletnya.
situation.en: Grandpa is shopping in a big mall and asks a shop assistant where the toilet is.

lines.speaker: yeye
lines.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

lines.speaker: seller
lines.pinyin: duì， zài nà gè mén de pángbiān。

situation.id: Sabtu siang. Adik ingin jalan-jalan ke mal, tapi di luar sedang hujan. Mereka memutuskan pesan taksi lewat aplikasi.
situation.en: Saturday afternoon. Little sister wants to go to the mall, but it's raining. They decide to book a taxi on an app.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: māma， wǒmen qù guàng jiē ba！

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: shāngchǎng bù yuǎn， wǒmen dǎchē qù。
lines.en: The mall isn't far, we'll take a taxi.
lines.id: Malnya nggak jauh, kita naik taksi saja.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.pinyin: hǎo ba， nà wǒmen chū mén ba。

situation.id: Sabtu pagi, Adik masih di tempat tidur. Ibu menyuruhnya bangun dan merapikan bajunya sebelum sarapan.
situation.en: Saturday morning, little sister is still in bed. Mom tells her to get up and put her clothes away before breakfast.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 九点了，别睡懒觉了！起床吧！
lines.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn le， bié shuì lǎn jiào le！ qǐchuáng ba！
lines.en: It's nine o'clock, stop sleeping in! Get up!
lines.id: Sudah jam sembilan, jangan tidur terus! Bangun!

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 衣服都在床上，你去放好。
lines.pinyin: yīfu dōu zài chuáng shàng， nǐ qù fàng hǎo。
lines.en: Your clothes are all on the bed, go and put them away.
lines.id: Bajunya berserakan di kasur, sana dirapikan.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.pinyin: hěn hǎo！ wǒmen chī zǎofàn ba。

situation.id: Ayah memesan taksi online untuk ke bandara dan mengobrol dengan sopirnya.
situation.en: Dad books a ride-hailing taxi to the airport and chats with the driver.

lines.speaker: driver
lines.pinyin: hǎo。 nǐ zuò fēijī？ jǐ diǎn de？
lines.en: OK. Catching a flight? What time?
lines.id: Baik. Mau naik pesawat? Jam berapa?

lines.speaker: baba
lines.pinyin: shí diǎn de。 lùshang chē duō ma？
lines.en: At ten. Is there much traffic on the way?

lines.speaker: driver
lines.pinyin: jīntiān bù dǔ chē， hěn kuài。
lines.en: No traffic jams today, it'll be quick.
lines.id: Hari ini nggak macet, cepat kok.

situation.id: Sore hari, Kakak bersiap keluar untuk bertemu teman. Ibu bertanya kapan dia pulang.
situation.en: In the late afternoon, big brother is getting ready to meet friends. Mom asks when he'll be back.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: I'm going out to see friends.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: Are you coming back for dinner?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.pinyin: bù huílái le。 huí tóu jiàn！
lines.en: No, I won't be back. See you later!

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: OK, come back a bit early.

situation.id: Adik pulang sekolah setelah ujian dan bercerita kepada Ibu.
situation.en: Little sister comes home after an exam and tells Mom about it.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: hěn nán！ wǒ kǎo zá le。

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: Never mind, study hard next time.
lines.id: Nggak apa-apa, lain kali belajar yang rajin.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.cmn: 我的同学考了一百。她是学霸！
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngxué kǎo le yī bǎi。 tā shì xué bà！
lines.en: My classmate got a hundred. She's a top student!
lines.id: Temanku dapat seratus. Dia jago banget belajarnya!

title.id: Orang asing yang bisa bahasa Mandarin

situation.id: Kakak bercerita kepada Kakek tentang orang asing yang mengajaknya mengobrol dalam bahasa Mandarin di taman.
situation.en: Big brother tells Grandpa about a foreigner who chatted with him in Chinese in the park.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 爷爷，今天一个老外跟我说汉语！
lines.pinyin: yéye， jīntiān yī gè lǎo wài gēn wǒ shuō Hànyǔ！
lines.en: Grandpa, today a foreigner spoke Chinese with me!
lines.id: Kek, hari ini ada bule ngajak aku ngomong bahasa Mandarin!

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 会！他的汉语很好，我们聊天了。
lines.pinyin: huì！ tā de Hànyǔ hěn hǎo， wǒmen liáo tiān le。
lines.en: Yes! His Chinese is very good, we had a chat.
lines.id: Bisa! Bahasa Mandarinnya bagus, kami ngobrol.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 他是外国学生，在北京学习。
lines.pinyin: tā shì wàiguó xuéshēng， zài Běijīng xuéxí。
lines.en: He's a foreign student studying in Beijing.
lines.id: Dia mahasiswa asing, kuliah di Beijing.

lines.speaker: yeye
lines.pinyin: hěn hǎo， nǐ yě yào xué wàiyǔ！
lines.en: Good, you should learn a foreign language too!
lines.id: Bagus, kamu juga harus belajar bahasa asing!

situation.id: Malam hari, Adik mengerjakan PR menulis huruf Mandarin dan minta bantuan Kakak.
situation.en: In the evening, little sister is doing her character-writing homework and asks big brother for help.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: gē， zhè gè zì wǒ gǎo bu dǒng。
lines.en: Bro, I can't figure out this character.
lines.id: Kak, huruf ini aku nggak ngerti.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 我看看。你先写这边，再写那边。
lines.pinyin: wǒ kàn kàn。 nǐ xiān xiě zhèbiān， zài xiě nàbiān。
lines.en: Let me see. Write this side first, then that side.
lines.id: Coba kulihat. Tulis bagian sini dulu, lalu bagian sana.

situation.id: Ayah pulang larut dari kantor. Ibu khawatir karena Ayah bekerja terlalu keras.
situation.en: Dad comes home late from the office. Mom worries that he is working too hard.

lines.speaker: baba
lines.pinyin: wǒ huílái le， tài lèi le！

lines.speaker: baba
lines.pinyin: hěn máng， xiàwǔ kāi le sān gè huì。
lines.en: Very. I had three meetings this afternoon.
lines.id: Sibuk, sore tadi rapat tiga kali.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.pinyin: nǐ shēntǐ bù hǎo， bié tài lèi le。
lines.en: You're not in great health, don't wear yourself out.
lines.id: Badanmu lagi kurang sehat, jangan terlalu capek.

lines.speaker: baba
lines.pinyin: méi shì， wǒ xiān xiūxi yīhuìr。
lines.en: I'm fine, I'll rest for a bit first.
lines.id: Nggak apa-apa, aku istirahat sebentar dulu.

situation.id: Nenek membeli buah di pasar pagi dan membayar dengan scan kode QR di HP.
situation.en: Grandma buys fruit at the morning market and pays by scanning a QR code with her phone.

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.pinyin: lǎo bǎn， zhè gè duōshao qián？

lines.speaker: seller
lines.id: Nggak mahal kok. Delapan yuan deh.

lines.speaker: seller
lines.pinyin: liǎng gè shí liù kuài， sǎo mǎ ba！
lines.en: Two is sixteen yuan, scan the code!
lines.id: Dua jadi enam belas yuan, silakan scan!

situation.id: Sabtu malam di rumah. Adik bosan, lalu Kakak mengajaknya menonton film baru di TV.
situation.en: Saturday evening at home. Little sister is bored, so big brother suggests watching a new film on TV.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.en: I'm so bored! What shall we do?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.pinyin: yī gè xīn diànyǐng， hěn hǎokàn。
lines.en: A new one, it's really good.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: zhè gè diànyǐng zhēn yǒu yìsi！

situation.id: Siang hari di musim panas. Adik dan temannya membeli teh susu di kedai bubble tea baru.
situation.en: A summer afternoon. Little sister and her friend buy milk tea at a new bubble tea shop.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.pinyin: duì！ wǒmen qù mǎi hē de ba！
lines.en: Yes! Let's go buy something to drink!

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: hǎo！ wǒ yào yī bēi lěng de。
lines.en: OK! I want a cold one.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.cmn: 你看，那边有一个新的商店。
lines.pinyin: nǐ kàn， nàbiān yǒu yī gè xīn de shāngdiàn。
lines.en: Look, there's a new shop over there.
lines.id: Lihat, di sana ada toko baru.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.pinyin: zhè gè chá zhēn bù cuò！

lines.speaker: friend
lines.pinyin: zhēnde？ wǒ juéde yī bān bān。
lines.en: Really? I think it's just so-so.
